related.title: Perlmutter：異質佇列的完成時間與資料就緒
related.titleEn: Perlmutter: heterogeneous queue time and data readiness
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付排列矩陣、成本分解、版本檢查及一份順序打亂後仍相同的驗證結果；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障；附可執行實作：python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-003 --out ./hpc-a-003-evidence；輸出資料夾須不存在，程式提供逐筆合成證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the permutation table, per-transfer cost breakdown, provenance checks and a shuffled-input regression. Explain exactly why matching device numbers are not an acceptable replacement for the lookup. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system. Executable fixture: python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-003 --out ./hpc-a-003-evidence. The output directory must not exist; the program emits per-record synthetic evidence.
related.difference: 以選項、等待估計時間戳、運算秒數、資料雜湊建立決策表；兩個二進位都先通過相同數值容差。
related.differenceEn: Build alternatives.csv with an option, timestamped wait estimate, runtime and input hash. Require both executables to pass the same numerical tolerance before treating them as interchangeable scheduling choices.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 把裝置到 NUMA 的映射視為查表函數，再對每條等量傳輸累加教學成本；成本單位是模型權重而非量測奈秒；八條傳輸，局部成本 2、遠端成本 9；名義全為局部，變更為六條局部與二條遠端；名義式 8*2 = 16 cost units；變更式 6*2+2*9 = 30 cost units。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
單階段估計完成時間為等待加運算；估計值必須有相同起點且包含資料已就緒的前提；CPU 路徑等待 60 秒、執行 540 秒；GPU 執行 120 秒，等待由 900 改為 300 秒；名義式 900+120 = 1020 s；變更式 300+120 = 420 s。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Treat device-to-NUMA placement as an explicit lookup, then sum the assigned costs of equal-sized transfers. Model cost units are pedagogical weights, not measured nanoseconds or a linear performance prediction. Supply a nonidentity permutation for eight devices. Local transfers cost 2 units and remote transfers cost 9. All eight are local initially; after changing two bindings, six remain local and two become remote. Nominal 8*2 = 16 cost units; changed 6*2+2*9 = 30 cost units. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

For the deliberately single-stage fixture, completion estimate equals queue wait plus execution time. All estimates share a submission timestamp and assume required data are already staged and verified. The CPU alternative waits 60 seconds and runs for 540. The GPU alternative runs for 120 seconds; its estimated wait changes from 900 to 300. These values are invented, not NERSC queue predictions. Nominal 900+120 = 1020 s; changed 300+120 = 420 s. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: cgroup v2：祖先限制與鄰居用量的容量帳本

related.difference: 建立父子樹與 usage、max、high 欄位；容量計算只用明示 max，high 另列為壓力控制而非硬容量替代。
related.differenceEn: Build the parent-child tree with usage, max and high fields. Use declared max values for this capacity calculation, while reporting high separately as a pressure-control setting rather than substituting it for a hard limit.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。

practice: 把裝置到 NUMA 的映射視為查表函數，再對每條等量傳輸累加教學成本；成本單位是模型權重而非量測奈秒；八條傳輸，局部成本 2、遠端成本 9；名義全為局部，變更為六條局部與二條遠端；名義式 8*2 = 16 cost units；變更式 6*2+2*9 = 30 cost units。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

在不可回收且無其他支出的簡化前提下，子群可用預算為 min(子上限,父上限－兄弟用量)；這不是核心下一次配置結果的預測；父上限 12 GiB、子上限 10 GiB；兄弟用量由 5 增為 8 GiB，其他用量固定為零；名義式 min(10,12-5) = 7 GiB；變更式 min(10,12-8) = 4 GiB。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

practiceEn: Treat device-to-NUMA placement as an explicit lookup, then sum the assigned costs of equal-sized transfers. Model cost units are pedagogical weights, not measured nanoseconds or a linear performance prediction. Supply a nonidentity permutation for eight devices. Local transfers cost 2 units and remote transfers cost 9. All eight are local initially; after changing two bindings, six remain local and two become remote. Nominal 8*2 = 16 cost units; changed 6*2+2*9 = 30 cost units. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Assuming no reclaimable memory or other charges, available child budget is the smaller of its own limit and parent headroom after sibling usage. This does not predict a kernel allocation’s exact outcome. Parent capacity is 12 GiB and the child limit is 10 GiB. Sibling use changes from 5 to 8 GiB, with zero other charges and no reclaim in this synthetic snapshot. Nominal min(10,12-5) = 7 GiB; changed min(10,12-8) = 4 GiB. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
